edges.reason: setOwner reads and overwrites the owner state variable.
constructor assigns owner from msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before setOwner body.
topupReward uses msg.sender as the token transfer source.
removeReward sends unallocated rewards to msg.sender under onlyOwner.
lockLiquidity keys liquidityRewardData by msg.sender.
rewardTask keys liquidityRewardData by msg.sender.
unlockLiquidity keys liquidityRewardData by msg.sender.
lockLiquidity stores block.timestamp as the stake start time.
rewardTask compares stake timestamp plus duration with block.timestamp.
calcReward reads LIQUIDITY_TOKEN for reserves and total supply.
topupReward reads REWARD_TOKEN for the transferFrom.
removeReward reads REWARD_TOKEN for the transferFrom.
rewardTask reads REWARD_TOKEN to approve and pay the reward.
lockLiquidity reads LIQUIDITY_TOKEN for the stake transferFrom.
unlockLiquidity reads LIQUIDITY_TOKEN to return staked tokens.
getRewardIndex compares unallocatedRewards with rewardLevels.
getRewardIndex reads rewardLevels thresholds.
getpoolLevelsIndex reads poolLevels thresholds.
getMonthsIndex reads monthLevels thresholds.
calcReward reads baseRateLookup.
calcReward reads multiplierLookup.
lockLiquidity validates stakeMonths against MAX_MONTHS.
rewardTask uses ONE_MONTH to derive the maturity timestamp.
lockLiquidity writes the liquidityRewardData stake record.
rewardTask reads and updates liquidityRewardData records.
unlockLiquidity reads and clears liquidityRewardData records.
lockLiquidity increases allocatedRewards by the computed reward.
rewardTask decreases or increases allocatedRewards.
lockLiquidity decreases unallocatedRewards by the reward.
rewardTask moves reward tokens between allocated and unallocated buckets.
lockLiquidity adds stakeTokens to totalUniswapLiquidity.
unlockLiquidity subtracts the stake quantity from totalUniswapLiquidity.
calcReward calls getpoolLevelsIndex for the multiplier row.
calcReward calls getRewardIndex for the base rate.
calcReward calls getMonthsIndex for the multiplier column.
topupReward calls findOnePercent to compute the burn amount.
lockLiquidity calls calcReward to size the reward.
rewardTask calls calcReward when renewing a stake.
unlockLiquidity calls rewardTask to settle pending rewards.
topupReward performs the REWARD_TOKEN transferFrom external call.
removeReward performs the REWARD_TOKEN transferFrom external call.
calcReward performs the getReserves external call.
calcReward performs the totalSupply external call.
lockLiquidity performs the LIQUIDITY_TOKEN transferFrom.
rewardTask approves and transfers reward tokens.
unlockLiquidity approves and transfers staked liquidity tokens.
lockLiquidity performs unchecked raw additions and subtraction of reward counters.
unallocatedRewards is mutated with unchecked raw arithmetic.
External LP token transfer in lockLiquidity executes before the stake record is written.
Reward token transferFrom in rewardTask can reenter while stake state is being updated.
Liquidity token transferFrom in unlockLiquidity can reenter before the record is cleared.
External reward token call in topupReward can reenter before unallocatedRewards is credited.
amount parameter flows into topupReward token transfer and burn math.
input array parameter is written into rewardLevels.
idx parameter selects the stake slot in lockLiquidity.
stakeMonths parameter is validated and stored in lockLiquidity.
stakeTokens parameter is transferred and recorded in lockLiquidity.
idx parameter selects the stake slot in rewardTask.
renewMonths parameter drives renewal in rewardTask.
idx parameter selects the stake slot in unlockLiquidity.
eth parameter is compared against poolLevels.
month parameter is compared against monthLevels.
_owner parameter becomes the new owner in setOwner.
stakeMonths parameter scales the reward in calcReward.
stakeTokens parameter becomes the liquidity amount in calcReward.
calcReward computes the local reward value.
rewardTask computes newReward when the stake is renewed.
topupReward computes tokensToBurn from findOnePercent.
topupReward computes the net actual deposit amount.
calcReward computes amountTokens from reserves and supply.
calcReward assigns the liquidity local from stakeTokens.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter has no independent identity outside topupReward and folds into that function.
The input array parameter is only used to set rewardLevels inside setRewardLevels.
The idx parameter is only meaningful as the lockLiquidity slot selector.
The stakeMonths parameter is local to lockLiquidity stake creation.
The stakeTokens parameter is local to lockLiquidity stake creation.
The idx parameter is only meaningful as the rewardTask slot selector.
The renewMonths parameter only drives the renewal branch of rewardTask.
The idx parameter is only meaningful as the unlockLiquidity slot selector.
The eth parameter is only consumed by getpoolLevelsIndex comparisons.
The month parameter is only consumed by getMonthsIndex comparisons.
The _owner parameter is only used to reassign owner in setOwner.
The stakeMonths parameter only scales the reward inside calcReward.
The stakeTokens parameter is only consumed by calcReward as the liquidity base.
The reward local is a computed intermediate of calcReward.
The newReward local is a computed intermediate of rewardTask renewal.
The tokensToBurn local is a computed intermediate of topupReward.
The actual local is a computed intermediate of topupReward.
The amountTokens local is a computed intermediate of calcReward.
The liquidity local is a trivial alias of stakeTokens inside calcReward.
